probes.question: According to Dr. Click N. Buy's survey, what share of the population now prefers shopping in their pajamas?
verbatim: revealed that 89% of the population now prefers shopping in their pajamas

probes.question: What did the cardboard sign that Localized Lady unfolded outside her boutique say?
probes.answer: "If you can find it online, you can buy it for 10% more here!"
verbatim: She unfolded a cardboard sign that read, "If you can find it online, you can buy it for 10% more here!"

probes.question: What did Jones say he missed about the cashier's job on November 5?
probes.answer: The days when 'checking out' meant more than just a quick glance at someone.
verbatim: I miss the days when 'checking out' meant more than just a quick glance at someone.

probes.question: According to Terry Quickship, how long after forgetting an order do customers often receive their packages?
probes.answer: Only about a week after they forgot they ordered it.
verbatim: I can’t tell you how many folks seem surprised when I drop off their package only a week after they forgot they ordered it.

probes.question: What have interactive workshops like "Make Your Own Candle and Then Burn It" begun to do for some local shops?
probes.answer: They have begun to lure some customers back from the depths of their electronic shopping carts.
